fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.plugins.devs

Class AtomicSimulatorPlugin

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.components.AbstractPlugin
      • fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.plugins.devs.AbstractSimulatorPlugin
        • fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.plugins.devs.AtomicSimulatorPlugin
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ModelStateAccessI, fr.sorbonne_u.components.PluginI, fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.interfaces.EventsExchangingI, java.io.Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    RTAtomicSimulatorPlugin

    public class AtomicSimulatorPlugin
extends AbstractSimulatorPlugin
implements ModelStateAccessI, fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.interfaces.EventsExchangingI
    The class AtomicSimulatorPlugin implements the behaviours required by a component that holds an atomic simulation model; it acts mostly as a facade for the simulation engine and model that it is holding, passing them most of the calls sometimes with adaptations (glue) to account for the fact that communication among simulation engines and models may pass through component connections.

    Description

    An atomic simulation plug-in is meant to manage the simulation models held by its component. As such, it performs operations to create the simulation architecture local to the component, for the interconnection of models during the creation of the global inter-components simulator architecture and during the simulation runs themselves to make its simulation engines and models execute the simulation steps.

      • storeInput

        public void storeInput(java.lang.String destinationURI,
                       java.util.ArrayList<fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.events.EventI> es)
        transmit the events to the model which destination is destinationURI.

        Contract

         pre     destinationURI != null && !destinationURI.isEmpty()
 pre     getRootModel() != null
 pre     getRootModel().getURI().equals(destinationURI) || (!getRootModel().isAtomic() && ((CoupledModel)getRootModel()).isDescendant(destinationURI))
 pre     !getRootModel().getURI().equals(destinationURI) || es.stream().allMatch(e -> { try { return isImportedEventType(e.getClass()); } catch (Exception e1) { throw new RuntimeException(e1) ; }})
 post    true        // no more postconditions.
        Specified by:
        storeInput in interface fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.interfaces.EventsExchangingI
        See Also:
        EventsExchangingI.storeInput(java.lang.String, java.util.ArrayList)

      • storeInput

        public void storeInput(java.util.Set<java.lang.String> destinationURIs,
                       java.util.ArrayList<fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.events.EventI> es)
        transmit all events to each of the models which URI appears in the set destinationURIs.

        Contract

         pre     destinationURIs != null && destinationURIs.stream().allMatch(uri -> uri != null && !uri.isEmpty())
 pre     getRootModel() != null
 pre     destinationURIs.stream().allMatch(uri -> getRootModel().getURI().equals(uri) || (!getRootModel().isAtomic() && ((CoupledModel)getRootModel()).isDescendant(uri))))
 pre     destinationURIs.stream().allMatch(uri -> !getRootModel().getURI().equals(destinationURI) || es.stream().allMatch(e -> { try { return isImportedEventType(e.getClass()); } catch (Exception e1) { throw new RuntimeException(e1) ; }}))
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        destinationURIs - URIs of atomic models to which the events must be transmitted.
        es - events to be transmitted.
